settings.description: Whether a chat turn offers the model tools. When it is off no tool is offered, and a tool a model asks for anyway is answered with a refusal.
How long one tool may run in a turn. A tool that runs longer is stopped, and the model is told it gave no result.
The most characters of one tool's result that are kept and sent back to the model. A longer result is cut, with a line that says so. Zero keeps every result whole.

settings.default: Keystone stopped here, because this reply reached the most steps one turn may take. Send another message to carry on from this point.
settings.description: What a reply ends with when a turn reaches chats.turn_max_steps while the model is still asking for tools. The person reads it in the chat, and the model reads it in later turns.
The most messages the read_chat tool returns from one chat. A longer chat comes back as its last messages.
The address web_search sends its searches to: Tavily's search API. The person's own key, stored as provider.tavily, goes with each search.
Tavily's search depth. A basic search costs one Tavily credit and an advanced one two.
How many results web_search returns when the model does not ask for a number.
The most results one web search may return, whatever number the model asks for. At most 20.
The most characters of each search result's text that the model reads.
How long one web search may take before it is given up, and the model is told it has no results.
The most bytes of a search provider's answer that are read. A larger answer is not used.
How long web_fetch may take to read one page, redirects included.
The most bytes of one page web_fetch reads. A longer page is read as far as this, and the model is told so.
The most characters of a page's readable text that web_fetch returns. A longer text is cut, with a line that says so.
The most redirects web_fetch follows for one page. Each one is checked like the first address: only public addresses are read.
